The '''CL-14 hyperdrive motivator''' was a model of [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]] produced by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]]. The [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], a [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|Minstrel-class space yacht]] owned by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], was equipped with a CL-14 hyperdrive motivator.<ref name="EGVV" />
